text_en: At the end of the turn, take fixed damage by the effect’s Count, then halve it.
text_zh: 回合结束时，受到等同于本效果层数的固定伤害，随后使本效果的层数减半。

text_en:
At the end of the turn, take fixed damage by the effect’s Potency.
Then, reduce its Count by 1.
text_zh: 回合结束时，受到{0}点固定伤害。持续{1}回合。

text_en:
When tossing an attack Coin, take fixed damage by the effect’s Potency.
Then, reduce its Count by 1.
text_zh: 下{1}次掷出攻击技能硬币时受到{0}点固定伤害。

text_en:
When hit by an attack, take fixed SP damage by the effect’s Potency.
(Non-SP Units take Gloom damage instead.)
Then, reduce its Count by 1.
text_zh: 下{1}次受到攻击时，额外受到{0}点固定理智伤害。(未带有理智值的目标则受到忧郁伤害)

text_en:
- Unique Sinking
- Base Value: 0, Max Value: 15
- The Potency and the Count of this effect are called "The Living" and "The Departed", respectively.
- When hit, the attacker heals (The Living/4) SP. (min 1; rounded down)
- When hit, and if this unit's SP is at less than 0, take (Sinking Potency/5) Gloom damage for every value of The Departed. (max Gloom damage 30; rounded down; deals half damage to targets that are Non-SP Units.)
- Turn End: Reset The Departed of this effect to 0; then, gain Sinking equal to The Living and convert The Living into The Departed.
- No external effects can raise the amount of Butterfly inflicted. "Inflict additional Sinking" effects inflict additional Sinking instead of additional Butterfly.
- This effect expires when both The Living and The Departed reach 0.
text_zh:
- 特殊沉沦
- 基础值：0，最大值：15
- 受到攻击时，使攻击者恢复{2}点理智值
- 受到攻击时，若自身的理智值低于0点，则使自身受到{3}点忧郁伤害
- 回合结束时，本效果的亡蝶变为0点，使自身增加相当于生蝶(强度)点数的沉沦 强度并将生蝶转换为亡蝶(层数)
- 生蝶与亡蝶均为0点时解除本效果

text_en:
- Unique Ammo
- The sum of Potency and Count maxes out at 20.
- Consumed for certain Skills.
- Whether The Living(Potency) or The Departed(Count) will be consumed for each shot is randomly determined
- Some attacks cancel if this unit runs out of ammo.
text_zh:
- 特殊弹药
- 强度与层数之和最大值：20
- 特定技能使用时消耗
- 消耗时，随机选择本效果的生蝶(强度)或亡蝶(层数)进行消耗
- 若消耗时本效果点数不足以消耗，则取消攻击

text_en:
- Effect applied to The Living & The Departed(Unique Ammo)
- Consume (30 - (The Living + The Departed))/2 SP. (rounded down)
- Reset both The Living and The Departed values on self to 0, and gain the max value of their sum based on the probabilities listed in the Passive 'ISeeTheDyingButterfly.'
- On Reload, gain at least 1 of The Living and The Departed.
text_zh:
- 消耗((30-自身带有的生蝶与亡蝶之和)/2)点理智值。(向下取整)
- 使自身的生蝶与亡蝶点数变为0点，根据被动“注视垂死之蝶。”中的概率获得相当于两种蝶之和最大值的点数
- 再次装填时，至少获得1点生蝶与亡蝶

text_en: Take more damage from skills based on the effect’s Count for one turn. (Max 10)
text_zh: 本回合内受到的伤害+{0}0%(最多+100%)

- 禁用被动技能“过去”
- 最大值：30

- 禁用被动技能“现在”
- 最大值：30

- 禁用被动技能“未来”
- 最大值：30

text_en:
- Passive "Past [過去]" activated
- Gain different effects based on Stack:
· 0~10: Skills inflict +1 more Burn Potency and Count
· 11~20: Clash Power +1; Skills inflict +2 more Burn Potency and +1 more Burn Count
· 21~30: Final Power +2; Skills inflict +3 more Burn Potency and +2 more Burn Count
- Max Stack: 30
text_zh:
- 激活被动技能“过去”
- 根据本效果层数获得不同效果：
· 0~10层：技能增加的烧伤 强度与施加的烧伤 层数额外+1
· 11~20层：拼点威力+1；技能增加的烧伤 强度额外+2级，施加的烧伤 层数额外+1层
· 21~30层：最终威力+2；技能增加的烧伤 强度额外+3级，施加的烧伤 层数额外+2层
- 最大值：30

text_en:
- Passive "Present [現在]" activated
- Gain different effects based on Stack:
· 0~10: Skills gain +1 more Poise Potency and Count
· 11~20: Clash Power +1; Skills gain +2 more Poise Potency and +1 more Poise Count
· 21~30: Final Power +2; Skills gain +3 more Poise Potency and +2 more Poise Count
- Max Stack: 30
text_zh:
- 激活被动技能“现在”
- 根据本效果层数获得不同效果：
· 0~10层：技能增加的呼吸法 强度与获得的呼吸法 层数额外+1
· 11~20层：拼点威力+1；技能增加的呼吸法 强度额外+2级，获得的呼吸法 层数额外+1层
· 21~30层：最终威力+2；技能增加的呼吸法 强度额外+3级，获得的呼吸法 层数额外+2层
- 最大值：30

text_en:
- Passive "Future [未來]" activated
- Gain different effects based on Stack:
· 0~10: Skills inflict +1 more Bleed Potency and Count
· 11~20: Clash Power +1; Skills inflict +2 more Bleed Potency and +1 more Bleed Count
· 21~30: Final Power +2; Skills inflict +3 more Bleed Potency and +2 more Bleed Count
- Max Stack: 30
text_zh:
- 激活被动技能“未来”
- 根据本效果层数获得不同效果：
· 0~10层：技能增加的流血 强度与施加的流血 层数额外+1
· 11~20层：拼点威力+1；技能增加的流血 强度额外+2级，施加的流血 层数额外+1层
· 21~30层：最终威力+2；技能增加的流血 强度额外+3级，施加的流血 层数额外+2层
- 最大值：30

text_en:
- Gain 1 Stack every time this unit switches between In the Past / In the Present / In the Future
- Take +(Stack x 15)% damage (max 150%)
- Turn Start: At 10 Stack, gain 5 Fragile
- Max Stack: 10
text_zh:
- 自身每次在过去形态/现在形态/未来形态间转换时，使本效果的层数增加1层
- 受到的伤害+(本效果层数×15)%(最多+150%)
- 回合开始时，若本效果层数为10层，则对自身施加5层易损 
- 最大值：10
